messages:
anya-ux: Heads up from today's design review: the stacked bar legend on the Costs dashboard is clickable (toggles series) but SR users can't tell which series is shown/hidden and there's no keyboard shortcut to cycle series. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/costs-legend.png sam_k: I can repro. Tab focus skips the legend items entirely, and NVDA reads the canvas as just 'graphic' with no details. ben-frontend: The chart lib renders legend inside an SVG . SVG elements are hard to annotate for SR. Options: render a separate DOM legend (preferred) or add invisible HTML buttons mirrored for assistive tech. leo-qa: Repro steps: Dashboard > Costs > Tab until canvas > try arrow keys > nothing. Also when toggling a series with mouse the visual stroke opacity changes but SR doesn't announce "series hidden". access-bot: scan: HIGH: interactive legend not reachable by keyboard; HIGH: missing state announcements (aria-pressed/aria-checked); MEDIUM: canvas lacks accessible name/description; LOW: color-only indication for hidden series. Recommend DOM controls + aria-live summary. anya-ux: Proposed pattern (sketch) — DOM legend synced with chart and an aria-live status: ```
Series Infra visible
``` This gives keyboard focus, toggles with Space/Enter, and announces state changes. sam_k: Agree. Two additional asks: 1) when a legend toggle occurs, update the canvas's accessible description to include a short summary like "3 series visible: Infra, Storage, Network"; 2) expose a keyboard shortcut (e.g., `Shift+L`) to open legend focus so power users can quickly keyboard into it. We'll gate the shortcut behind a user preference toggle. ben-frontend: Implementation notes: I'll output the DOM legend next to the SVG/canvas and hook into chart events. For aria-live messages, throttle updates so we don't spam SRs when many series toggle quickly. Use a short queue and announce the final state after 250ms debounce. leo-qa: Tests: 1) Keyboard: Tab to legend, Space toggles series, aria-live contains "hidden"/"visible"; 2) Shortcut: Shift+L focuses first legend item (test in mac+VO and windows+NVDA); 3) Canvas description updates to list visible series. access-bot: extra nit: for multi-select toggles, aria-pressed is good. Alternatively, role=\"menuitemcheckbox\" + aria-checked works too. Either is acceptable; document choice. Also ensure color change isn't the only cue: add an icon or pattern for hidden series. anya-ux: UX: add a small eye/eye-off icon next to legend text for visible/hidden state and keep opacity change on the chart. Also keep the legend visually tight and ensure focus outline token for legend items meets contrast (recommend `--focus-legend: 3px solid #ffb86b`). ben-frontend: Will implement DOM legend, aria-live debounce, canvas aria-description update, and optional Shift+L shortcut behind prefs. I'll file a small PR targeting next patch. sam_k: I'll add E2E keyboard tests and a unit test that the aria-description string matches visible series names after toggles. Also add telemetry for keyboard legend usage. leo-qa: I'll run cross-platform SR passes once PR is ready. Also check that screen readers don't double-announce (legend + live region) — we want a single clear announcement. anya-ux: Great — keep the change scoped. @ben-frontend please include screenshots and a short accessibility checklist in your PR description. Thanks team :raised_hands:
